ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Day Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of day care fraud in Minnesota, and follow the money to uncover the extent of the corruption.
questions: How widespread is the day care fraud in Minnesota?
Who is behind the fraud and how much money is involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale corruption scheme, and could lead to significant reforms in the state's handling of federal funds. I recommend starting with a thorough analysis of the state's financial records, and interviewing officials involved in the day care funding process.
